name: Cable High-to-Low Fly
steps: Set both pulleys above head height, grasp one handle in each hand, and step forward into a balanced staggered stance.
Lean your torso slightly forward, lift your chest, and hold a slight fixed bend in both elbows.
Sweep both arms downward and inward in a wide arc until your hands meet in front of your lower hips.
Squeeze your chest briefly, then open your arms smoothly back up until you feel a comfortable chest stretch.
tips: Keep your shoulders depressed away from your ears and avoid turning the fly into a pressing motion.
Hold a constant slight bend in your elbows as your hands sweep down and back up.
